prompt: I just finished a feature and want to run the opencode-coder simplify workflow with focus on duplication. Explain exactly how you would scope the review, what review passes you would run, what changes are safe to apply directly, and what bigger changes you would ask me about first.
assertions: Starts scope selection from recent git changes including staged or unstaged diffs
Calls for three review passes covering duplication, code quality, and efficiency
Distinguishes safe local simplifications from broader ask-first refactors
Includes the expected closing summary fields such as scope, focus, applied, deferred or ask-first, validation, and follow-up
